_comment: Generated by ConfigKnobsExportTest (MOD-700) - do not edit by hand. One entry per @Knob: key, section, type, compiled default, min/exclusive/floorTo, doc. Refresh: run the test, then python docs/tools/lib/config_knobs_lib.py --accept.

knobs.doc: Multiplier on EVERY generator's EU/t output. 1.0 = unchanged; 2.0 = twice the generation server-wide.
Machine speed multiplier (energy-neutral): higher = machines draw more EU/t but finish proportionally faster. 1.0 = unchanged.
Evolved daylight-panel output in EU/t during the day.
Fuel (solid-burnable) generator output in EU/t while burning.
Fuel generator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Geothermal generator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Ticks of burn a geothermal generator gets per bucket of lava (20 ticks = 1 second).
Geothermal (lava) generator output in EU/t while burning lava.
Blocks of height above sea level per +1 EU/t of base on the high-altitude T2 variant.
High-altitude wind mill (T2) clear-sky height cap in EU/t.
Hard cap on high-altitude T2 wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
High-altitude T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is raining.
High-altitude T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
MOD-386: EU/t the T1 tip bleeds from its capacitor into the buffer, before its grade multiplier.
MOD-386: capacitor size of the T1 conductor tip before its grade multiplier. Keep in step with lightningRodStrikeEu — one strike is meant to fit an empty T1 tip exactly.
MOD-386: internal EU buffer of the lightning rod generator block.
MOD-386: ceiling on the bleed rate after the grade multiplier (LV tier voltage). No multiplier can lift it.
MOD-386: ceiling on a conductor tip's capacitor after its grade multiplier. No multiplier can lift it.
MOD-386: extra tip wear charged when a strike is wasted on a full capacitor (1.0 = no extra penalty).
MOD-386: one-in-N chance per tick of a strike in plain rain without thunder (vanilla never does this; the rod does). Higher = rarer.
MOD-386: how often the rod re-reads storm/open-sky conditions, in ticks. Cached in between, like the wind mill's height/sky sample.
MOD-386: EU one lightning strike delivers into the conductor tip's capacitor. Surplus over the tip's free room is lost, never banked.
MOD-386: one-in-N chance per tick of a strike while thundering over the rod (900 ~ one strike every 45 s of storm). Higher = rarer.
MOD-386: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced tip, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
MOD-386: advanced conductor tip max durability (×6 the copper one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-386: advanced tip capacity/bleed scale — reaches both ceilings, which is the top grade's point.
MOD-386: EU banked per 1 durability point of the T1 conductor tip (life = maxDamage × this).
MOD-386: T1 conductor tip max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate.
MOD-386: capacity/bleed scale of the T1 conductor tip — the ladder's 1.0 baseline.
MOD-386: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced tip, scaled by its ×1.25 output so the life gain is purely the durability gain.
MOD-386: reinforced conductor tip max durability (×3 the copper one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-386: reinforced tip capacity/bleed scale. Applied before the caps, so it cannot raise them.
Extra percent of power a mob wheel runner gets while the condition its kind favours holds.
Mob wheel output of every species, in percent of its table power (100 = as designed).
How many times faster an exhausted mob rests with a hay bale within 2 blocks of the wheel.
Ticks an exhausted mob needs to rest back to full on its own, before its kind's own rest multiplier and hay.
Mob wheel stamina of every species, in percent of its table stamina (100 = as designed).
Evolved moonlit-panel output in EU/t at night under clear sky.
Moonlit-panel EU/t at night during rain/thunder (a weather trickle).
Assembled Mirror Concentrator output in EU/t during the day, before the noon peak.
Mirror Concentrator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Mirror Concentrator output in EU/t during the day, before the noon peak.
Solar panel EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Solar panel output in EU/t under clear daytime sky. The energy system's baseline (1).
Active sky-time ticks needed to evolve a base solar panel into its T2 branch.
How often (ticks) a solar panel re-samples sky access + weather; verdict is cached between samples.
Output multiplier under snow (a snow layer above, or snowfall in a cold biome).
Output multiplier when a solar panel sees sky through a translucent block (leaves, cobweb).
Storm wind mill (T2) clear-sky height cap in EU/t before the weather multiplier.
Hard cap on storm T2 wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
Storm T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is raining.
Storm T2 wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
Shared EU buffer for both T2 wind mills (high-altitude + storm). Applies to newly placed blocks.
Water mill EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Water mill EU/t per adjacent water block on its four sides (0..4 EU/t total).
MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced wheel, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
MOD-385: advanced wheel max durability (×6 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-385: advanced wheel output scale.
EU of production per 1 durability point of the water mill wheel (life = maxDamage × this). Read live every tick.
Water mill wheel max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate.
MOD-385: output scale of the plain wooden wheel — the ladder's 1.0 baseline.
MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced wheel, scaled by its ×1.25 output.
MOD-385: reinforced wheel max durability (×3 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-385: reinforced wheel output scale. The water mill has no EU/t cap of its own — its ceiling is 4 wheel cells × waterMillEuPerTick.
Cloud deck Y: the windiest height. Wind climbs to here and collapses above it (shared by all wind mills and the Wind Gauge).
Y above which only a trace of wind remains — too little to turn any rotor.
Clear-weather wind speed in km/h at the cloud deck — the Wind Gauge's full-scale reading.
Wind mill (T1) EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Active open-sky ticks (with rotor + evolution chip) to evolve a base wind mill into its T2 branch.
Wind mill base EU/t at the cloud deck; the altitude profile scales it (MOD-347).
Hard cap on wind mill EU/t after the weather multiplier.
Wind mill output multiplier while it is raining (not thundering).
MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the advanced rotor, scaled by its ×1.5 output.
MOD-385: advanced rotor max durability (×6 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-385: advanced rotor output scale. Applied before the mill's cap.
EU of production per 1 durability point of the wind mill rotor (life = maxDamage × this). Read live every tick.
Wind mill rotor max durability (bar). Applies at registration (restart); tune life via the EU-per-damage rate. Shared by all three wind mills.
MOD-385: output scale of the plain wooden rotor — the ladder's 1.0 baseline. Raising it buffs every wind mill, not just upgraded ones.
MOD-385: EU per 1 durability point of the reinforced rotor. Scaled by its ×1.25 output so the life gain is purely the durability gain.
MOD-385: reinforced rotor max durability (×3 the wooden one). Applies at registration (restart).
MOD-385: reinforced rotor output scale. Applied before the mill's cap, so it cannot raise windMillMaxEuPerTick.
How often (ticks) a wind mill re-samples height/sky/weather; rate is cached in between.
Extra rotor wear multiplier while running in rain/thunder (1.0 = off). Applies to all three wind mills.
Wind mill output multiplier while it is thundering.
Fraction of full wind strength reached at a mill branch's ridge; the rest is gained over the shoulder up to windCloudY.
Fraction of full wind strength left above windDeadY (readable on the gauge, 0 EU/t for mills).
Fallback ticks one alloying operation takes at 1.0 speed (MOD-064); shipped recipe energy 1200 / alloySmelterEuPerTick 8 = 150.
EU/t the alloy smelter draws while running (MOD-064). Four times the machine standard, like the incubator.
EU buffer of the assembler (MOD-275) — 25 operations at 480 EU each.
Ticks one assembler craft takes at 1.0 speed (MOD-275). 40 = 2 seconds, the pace of the genre.
EU/tick the assembler draws while crafting (MOD-275). MV rate: six times an LV machine.
Food value in tenths (nutrition + saturation) the canning machine consumes per ration. Must exceed the ration's own 96, or canning becomes a food duplicator.
Ticks the canning machine takes per ration at 1.0 speed; x machineEuPerTick 2 = 200 EU per ration.
Plates one carbon briquette yields when a piston fires into the water it floats in.
Redstone dust the press consumes per briquette, alongside the briquette itself.
MOD-393: banked EU needed before the condenser can yield a tier-I energy clot.
MOD-393: banked EU for a tier-II clot (four times tier I).
MOD-393: banked EU for a tier-III clot (four times tier II).
Ticks a compressor takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
MOD-393: ceiling of the energy condenser's bank; equals the tier-III clot threshold, so it stops drawing once nothing higher is reachable.

MOD-393: EU/t the energy condenser accepts — one MV packet, about 32 basic solar panels. Machines are protected by the network's serve order, not by this number; absorbing a bigger surplus means placing more condensers.
Energy buffer of a crystal farm controller, in EU.
Ticks a hand-opened greenhouse door stays open before sealing itself; a door held open by redstone ignores this.
Ticks the greenhouse door waits before re-testing a doorway that still has someone standing in it.
EU one boosted growth event costs; charged only when the event actually happens.
1-in-this chance a seedbed advances on one attempt with no water and no power; lower it to single digits to watch a farm work during a test.
Ticks between growth attempts on every seedbed in a greenhouse.
Factor a powered attempt cuts the crystal growth divisor by, on top of water.
Largest interior volume of a crystal greenhouse, in blocks; past it the room reads as unsealed.
How far from its controller a greenhouse fill may reach, in blocks; keeps a leaking room from scanning into unloaded terrain.
Smallest interior volume of a crystal greenhouse, in blocks; the room may be any shape, so this is a volume rather than an edge length.
Ticks between full re-scans of a crystal greenhouse by its controller; also refreshes its seedbed list and water check.
mB of nutrient solution one sprinkler-boosted growth event costs; charged only when the event happens.
Factor a sprinkler in the room cuts the crystal growth divisor by, on top of water and power.
Factor water in the room cuts the crystal growth divisor by.
Buds one amethyst shard buys when fed to a seedbed; shards go in one per click, so this is the exchange rate of the whole farm.
Fallback ticks one distillation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 400 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 200.
Ticks a cold distillation column heats (at machineEuPerTick) before it can distil; cooling is twice as slow.
Ticks an electric furnace takes per smelt at 1.0 speed.
Electric Heater EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
EU/t an Electric Heater spends while the Vulcanizer directly above it advances; idle heater draws nothing.
MOD-418: paid heat ticks a cold Electric Heater needs before it supplies tier-3 heat (x3 output); until then it supplies tier 2 (x2). Cooling is twice as slow.
Ticks an extractor takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
mB of biofuel a batch of ordinary harvest brews (wheat, carrots, melon slices, raw meat).
mB of biofuel a batch of the cheapest organic tier brews (seeds, grass, leaves, rot).
mB of biofuel a batch of processed or dense feedstock brews (golden carrots, cooked food, hay blocks).
Fallback ticks one fermenter batch takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 600 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 300.
mB of water a fermenter batch consumes (not part of the recipe JSON).
Fallback ticks a galvanic bath operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 1000 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 500.
mB of water a galvanic bath consumes per completed operation (not part of the recipe JSON).
Garden Drone station internal EU buffer.
EU per completed Garden Drone action (till/plant/fertilize/harvest/weed); idle costs nothing.
Ticks the Garden Drone flies per block of distance before its action lands.
Garden Drone zone-scan radius in blocks around the station.
Ticks between Garden Drone zone rebuilds after cache invalidation.
Incubator internal EU buffer.
EU/t the incubator draws while running (4x the machine standard).
mB of water an incubator attempt drinks (not part of the recipe JSON).
Per cent faster an incubator runs while its nutrient bath has water (0 disables).
Ticks the (fuel-based) iron furnace takes to smelt one item. Vanilla furnace = 200.
Macerator EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Ticks a macerator takes per operation at 1.0 speed.
Shared EU buffer for ordinary LV processing machines: electric furnace, compressor, extractor, sawmill, polymerizer and vulcanizer. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Base EU/t a processing machine draws while running (energy per operation = this x its duration).
Mob Repeller LV internal EU buffer.
Mob Repeller HV internal EU buffer.
Mob Repeller MV internal EU buffer.
Mob Repeller LV field upkeep in EU per tick while enabled (constant drain, not per expulsion).
Mob Repeller HV field upkeep in EU per tick.
Mob Repeller MV field upkeep in EU per tick.
Personal hostile kills to evolve the MV repeller into HV; also the vessel hard cap.
Personal hostile kills a Soul Vessel needs to evolve the LV repeller into MV.
Mob Repeller LV zone radius in blocks (a cube around the block).
Mob Repeller HV zone radius in blocks.
Mob Repeller MV zone radius in blocks.
Ticks between Mob Repeller zone sweeps (the upkeep drain still applies every tick).
Mutation attempts one uranium ingot powers before it burns to ash.
Ceiling on the total mutation success chance (base + gene bonus).
Base success chance of a create mutation (0..1).
Base success chance of a duplicate mutation (0..1).
Base success chance of a transform mutation (0..1).
Ticks an incubator create attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
Ticks an incubator duplicate attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
Ticks an incubator transform attempt takes at 1.0 speed.
Share of successful mutations rolling the epic grade.
Share of successful mutations rolling the legendary grade.
Share of successful mutations rolling the rare grade.
Share of attempts yielding irradiated slag instead of an empty miss.
MOD-392: EU/t multiplier per overclocker chip (2.0 = each chip doubles the draw). With 0.8 speed this makes every chip cost 60% more energy per operation.
MOD-392: absolute ceiling on overclocker chips in one machine; the tier cap (base EU/t x factor^n <= tier voltage) usually bites first.
MOD-392: duration multiplier per overclocker chip (0.8 = each chip cuts one operation to 80% of its length).
Ticks a polymerizer takes to turn one bucket of oil into raw rubber at 1.0 speed.
Top of the bare reactor's instability scale.
Instability a bare reactor gains per rod per tick; against the settle rate this sets how many racks a lava farm may carry.
Ticks between melts under a bare reactor carrying one rod; divided by the rod count.
Shortest gap between two melts under a bare reactor however large the cluster grows.
Blocks around a working bare reactor within which the scenery melts.
Hard ceiling on a bare reactor's output in EU/t, however many rods are piled into it.
Share of the sealed-room output a bare reactor keeps, in percent.
Blocks a controller with no sealed room reaches when looking for fuel racks; wider than the melt radius.
Share of current instability a bare reactor sheds per tick, per mille.
Explosion power of a reactor carrying no rods; below what it takes to break a reactor wall.
Longest countdown between a pinned gauge and the explosion, in ticks.
Shortest countdown between a pinned gauge and the explosion, in ticks; rolled fresh per accident.
When true, a core pinned at the top of its scale counts down and explodes. false keeps the countdown, the siren and the panel and changes no block.
Whether the blast sets fire to what it touches.
Lava sources poured into the crater, only into cells the explosion itself destroyed.
Hard ceiling on explosion power; a sealed room contains everything up to about 24.
Explosion power added per ten rods burning when the countdown ran out.
How long the core must stay under a hundred percent before an armed countdown is called off; stops a redstone clock resetting it.
EU buffer of the reactor controller.
Ticks the reactor button stays pressed before releasing itself.
Steam a single reactor column holds before cooling stalls, in mB.
Water a single reactor column holds, in mB.
Percentage of the heat scale the reactor must fall below before the warning siren can sound again; below the warning threshold on purpose.
Ticks the airlock waits before re-testing a doorway that still has someone standing in it.
Ticks the reactor airlock stays open after a redstone pulse before closing itself; holding the signal does not extend it.
Ticks the airlock panel takes to slide its full two blocks; cosmetic only, the open state still flips in one tick.
EU/t one fully lowered uranium rod contributes, before neighbour bonuses.
Percent chance per random tick that a fallout block fades one step; water on top doubles it.
Dose one fallout block delivers per radiation sweep; must exceed radiationTickInterval or its own decay cancels it.
Whether an explosion leaves irradiated ground behind.
How many fallout blocks one player ever counts, however large the scar.
Blocks around the epicentre within which fallout may settle, on top of what the blast destroyed.
Maximum of the reactor heat scale.
Extra heat a stopped reactor room sheds per tick, in thousandths of the current temperature.
Extra heat in percent per adjacent loaded reactor column; larger than the energy bonus, which is what makes a dense core hotter for the same power.
Heat units added per active rod per tick at full depth.
Heat units carried away by one mB of water as it boils into steam.
Percentage of the heat scale above which the reactor reports running hot.
Ticks between a block being marked for melting and turning to lava; the pointed warning the player can act on.
Heat carried away by one melted block of the room's contents; what makes a meltdown self-limiting.
Ticks between two blocks of the room's contents melting while the core is over the meltdown line.

When true, an overheating sealed room melts its own contents, a working sealed room melts the ordinary fluid and steam pipes inside it, and a working bare reactor melts the scenery around it. false keeps every cue and changes no block.
Percentage of the heat scale at which a sealed room starts melting its own contents; between the warning line and the top.
Extra output in percent granted per adjacent loaded fuel assembly; heat scales with it too.
Steam a nozzle holds, in mB.
Ticks a steam nozzle gathers its vented steam before drawing one geyser burst for it.
Steam a nozzle releases into the world per tick, in mB.
EU a single reactor outlet holds before a cable drains it.
Heat units a stopped reactor room bleeds away on its own each tick regardless of temperature; a running one sheds nothing but what its water carries.
Ticks between two ordinary fluid or steam pipes melting inside a working sealed reactor room; the reinforced pipes are immune.
Fluid a single reactor inlet passes per tick, in mB.
Ticks of burn in one uranium fuel rod at full control-rod depth.
Largest share of a reactor shell that may be glass, in percent; above it the room reports a weak structure.
Largest interior edge of a reactor room, in blocks; bounds both the scan cost and how much one room can hold.
Smallest interior edge of a reactor room, in blocks.
Ticks between full re-scans of a reactor room by its controller; catches shell changes out of neighbour range.
Ticks between the steam puffs over a sealed reactor room's boiling column stacks.
Boiling column stacks that puff steam in one pulse; the rest take turns on later pulses.
Slag mass a recycler batch must reach before it casts a briquette.
Items a diamond recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
Items an iron recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
Items a tempered-iron recycler blade set grinds before it wears out.
Ticks a recycler takes to grind one item at 1.0 speed, before the blade grade.
EU per tick a recycler draws while grinding.
EU/t the component repair bench draws while repairing (MOD-384). Four times the machine standard, like the alloy smelter.

MOD-384: percent of the ORIGINAL durability ceiling one repair burns, linear (1000 -> 800 -> 600 -> 400). Also sets how many repairs a part gets (four at 20%). 0 disables the decay and the limit with it.
MOD-384: EU one repair of a T1 rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 iron plate). 9600 EU / 8 EU-t = 1200 ticks (60 s).
MOD-384: EU one repair of a reinforced rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 tempered iron plate). 19200 EU / 8 EU-t = 2400 ticks (120 s).
MOD-384: EU one repair of an advanced rotor/wheel costs (material: 1 electronic circuit). 28800 EU / 8 EU-t = 3600 ticks (180 s).
Ticks a sawmill takes per cut at 1.0 speed (all four modes).
Ticks between sprinkler spray attempts.
Sprinkler spray radius in blocks around the block.
mB of nutrient solution one successful spray on a vanilla crop costs.
Sprinkler tank size in mB; also caps how fast a pipe can fill it.
Fallback ticks a thermal centrifuge operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 800 / thermalCentrifugeEuPerTick 4 = 200.
EU/t a thermal centrifuge spends while spinning up or processing; with the heater below the pair draws 10 EU/t.
EU/t a spun-up thermal centrifuge spends holding revolutions with nothing to process.
Ticks a stopped centrifuge rotor needs to reach working speed after the redstone signal arrives; it sheds speed at half this rate.
Ticks the Upgrade Table takes to fit one module.
EU/t the Upgrade Table draws while fitting a module.
Fallback ticks a vulcanizer operation takes at 1.0 speed; shipped recipe energy 400 / machineEuPerTick 2 = 200.
MOD-483: EU/t the assembled Workstation draws while powered. Charged per elapsed tick, at most a second per debit.
MOD-483: EU the Workstation spends per skill learned. Flat - the Ala-Fragment cost already scales with depth.
Battery Box EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks (already-placed keep their capacity until the chunk reloads).
Reinforced Energy Storage (MV) EU buffer. Applies to newly placed blocks (already-placed keep their capacity until the chunk reloads).
Charging Station EU buffer. Sized to a visit, not an operation: the station banks power while idle so it can charge a player's gear in one burst. Applies to newly placed blocks.
Max EU/t the Charging Station accepts from the grid. A ceiling, not a promise - a copper cable delivers 12, a gold one 48, an adjacent Battery Box 32.
Max EU/t the Charging Station hands to the player standing on it, shared across every powered item they carry (each item still capped by its own input rate).
EU/tick a storage block feeds a non-cascade sink (teleporter, charging station) over cable. 0 disables the channel.
Share of its capacity a storage block keeps for itself when feeding a non-cascade sink over cable (0..1). Below this line the channel is shut, so a teleporter can never drain the base's bank.
Per-cable working EU buffer — the live transport-segment buffer (MOD-070). Tiny by design so a wall of cables can't be used as bulk storage. Applies to newly placed cables.
Fraction of throughput attenuated per copper cable block (0.02 = 2% of the remaining flow per block).
Per-segment working EU buffer of an electrum (HV) cable = its real throughput (192 EU/t, 4x gold).
Fraction of throughput attenuated per electrum cable block (0.005 = 0.5% of the remaining flow per block; the lowest in the mod - electrum pays in craft cost, not in distance).
Per-segment working EU buffer of a gold (MV) cable = its real throughput (48 EU/t, 4x copper).
Fraction of throughput attenuated per gold cable block (0.03 = 3% of the remaining flow per block; worse than copper by design - gold buys throughput, not distance).
Multiplier applied to bare-cable attenuation for rubber-insulated tin/copper cables (0.5 = half the loss; throughput and packet cap are unchanged).
Per-segment working EU buffer of a tin cable = its real throughput (8 EU/t, narrower than copper's 12).
Fraction of throughput attenuated per tin cable block (0.006 = 0.6% of the remaining flow per block; a 1 EU/t solar trickle floors to zero loss).
Per-tick ceiling on EU drawn from one source through a tin cable (8 EU/t, below the LV tier voltage by design).
When true, energized bare cables damage players on direct contact and emit shock feedback. false disables the entire mechanic.
Damage from direct contact with an energized bare HV cable, in half-hearts.
Absorbed shock damage that costs one durability point on each worn insulating piece (higher = the set lasts longer; contact is once per second, so this is a rate).
Percent of a bare cable's shock cut by one worn piece of insulating armour (25 = a full four-piece set is immune; 0 disables the set's protection).
Damage from direct contact with an energized bare LV cable, in half-hearts.
Damage from direct contact with an energized bare MV cable, in half-hearts.
Extra blocks the shock hazard reaches beyond a bare cable segment's own cell in every direction (0 = direct-touch only).
Field at which the counter moves from occasional clicks to an audible rattle.
Field at which the Geiger counter starts clicking. Below it the instrument is silent.
Field at which the counter's rattle becomes dense.
Field above which the Geiger counter stops telling levels apart and just roars.
How far a Geiger counter hears uranium ore still in the rock. Ore in the wall gives no dose at all — this only moves the needle. 0 disables the ore scan.
How far a Geiger counter hears radiation. Larger than the radius radiation actually reaches, on purpose: the counter has to warn before the dose starts.
Loudness of the Geiger counter's clicks, in percent. 0 silences it; players also have the vanilla Players volume slider.
How deep to look inside carried containers for radioactive contents; 1 = a shulker box of fuel rods irradiates its carrier.

How many items' worth of radiation one container in the world may leak regardless of how much it holds; 0 stops containers radiating entirely. Without a cap a chest of refined uranium killed instantly across the whole radius.
Ticks between radiation hits at dose level II.
Ticks between radiation hits at dose level III.
Ticks between radiation hits at the top of the dose scale.
Damage per radiation hit at the top of the dose scale, in half-hearts.
Damage per radiation hit below the lethal line, in half-hearts.
Depth of the radiation dose scale in ticks; also the time a player at the top of the scale needs to recover once clear of every source.
Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_high (refined uranium, isotopes, fuel rods). Uncapped: a loose stack kills.
Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_low (ore, dust, shavings, depleted rods).
Dose per sweep per carried item of tag radioactive_medium (uranium ingots and plates).
Dose the shielding suit absorbs per point of durability spent; the suit is a consumable, not a permanent answer.
When true, uranium and fuelled reactor rods irradiate players. false disables the entire mechanic, including suit wear.
Blocks around the player in which dropped radioactive items are counted as a source.
Percent of the dose scale that tag radioactive_low alone can reach; inside level I on purpose, so raw ore sickens but never kills.
Percent of the dose scale at which an irradiated villager or cow transforms.
Ticks between the light hits an irradiated villager takes before it transforms.
When true, radiation turns villagers and wandering traders into zombie villagers and cows into mooshrooms. false disables all three transformations.
Dose per sweep from a fuelled reactor rod in line of sight, before shielding.
Ceiling on suit protection against a rod in line of sight; below 100 on purpose, so a full suit buys working time inside a live reactor rather than immunity.
Percent of incoming dose each worn shielding-suit piece blocks; four pieces block all ordinary exposure.
Blocks a fuelled rod irradiates through open air; a shell block in the way stops it entirely.
Ticks between re-applying the visible radiation symptoms (nausea, weakness, hunger).
Ticks between radiation exposure sweeps per player.
Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a glass insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).
Contact ticks a player is spared after an insulating stand absorbs a shock, so the reduced chance is per contact rather than re-rolled every tick.
Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a plank insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).
Chance (0..1) a shock still lands through a wool insulating stand under a bare cable (1 = no protection, 0 = blocks every hit).
Fluid networks processed per server tick; the rest round-robin to later ticks.
Cap on networks the Network Analyzer's Traverse mode walks (visualization only, never affects energy).
Max awake energy networks processed per server tick; the rest are deferred round-robin.
Default internal buffer capacity for HV machines. EnergyTier.HV reads it live.
Max packet voltage for the HV tier (4x MV by convention). EnergyTier.HV reads it live.
Default internal buffer capacity for LV machines that do not override it. EnergyTier.LV reads it live.
Max packet voltage (EU) and per-tick transfer cap for the LV tier (cable, generator, machine, storage). EnergyTier.LV reads it live.
Default internal buffer capacity for MV machines. EnergyTier.MV reads it live.
Max packet voltage for the MV tier (4x LV by convention). EnergyTier.MV reads it live.
Battery EU buffer, PER ITEM (a stack of 16 carries 16x this).
Max EU/t one battery accepts while charging in a slot.
EU one right-click moves from the battery into the item in the other hand.
Electric Bow EU buffer.
EU the bow spends per powered shot (below this it shoots as a plain bow for free).
Max EU/t the bow accepts while charging in a slot.
Electric Chainsaw EU buffer.
EU the chainsaw spends per block cut at powered speed (below this it cuts at hand speed for free).
Max EU/t the chainsaw accepts while charging in a slot.
Electric Drill EU buffer.
EU the drill spends per extra block of a column bore (the block above and below the one hit).
EU the drill spends per block mined at powered speed (below this it mines at hand speed for free).
Max EU/t the drill accepts while charging in a slot.
Netherite-Tipped Electric Drill EU buffer (the two tiers below share electricDrillBuffer).
EU the drill spends to place a torch on right-click.
Electric Hoe EU buffer.
EU the hoe spends per block broken at powered speed (below this it breaks at hand speed for free). Tilling is powered too and is billed separately by electricHoeTillEuCost.
Max EU/t the hoe accepts while charging in a slot.
EU the hoe spends per successful right-click conversion (tilling soil).
Electric Saber EU buffer.
EU the saber spends per powered hit (below this it hits as a plain sword for free).
Max EU/t the saber accepts while charging in a slot.
Seconds of Slowness II a powered saber hit leaves on the target (0 disables).

MOD-483 Dielectric: percent by which a bare cable hits weaker.
MOD-483 Dosimetrist: Geiger counter reach in blocks with the skill (base geigerRadius applies without it).

MOD-483 Field Circuit: divisor on the pack's output rate while it sits in a bag rather than worn (2 = half speed). Keeps wearing it worthwhile.
MOD-483 Fine Tuning: further percent off machine operation length, added to skillTunedDrivePercent.
MOD-483 Frugal Armour: one second of powered-armour upkeep in this many is free (3 = a third off). Counted in seconds because upkeep is 1 EU and a percent of one rounds to nothing.
MOD-483 Frugal Sprayer / Frugal Vat: percent less solution or water one action takes.
MOD-483 Frugal Stroke: powered-tool action cost as a percent of the listed price (90 = 10% off). Rounded UP, so a 2 EU action is not halved.
MOD-483 Full Insulation: percent by which a bare cable hits weaker. Together with a full insulating set it reaches the mod cap of 95%, never immunity.
MOD-483 Precise Draw: one drain tick in this many is free (10 = 10% off the operation). Counted in ticks because a basic machine draws 2 EU/t.
MOD-483 Quick Docking: multiplier on how fast powered items accept charge (1.5 = half again). The voltage tier ceiling still applies above it.
MOD-483 Recuperator: percent of a tool's spend returned to the worn energy pack. Never applies to a carrier's own payout - that would mint EU.
MOD-483 Resilient Cycle: percent of an operation that must be done before it may finish on the machine's own buffer. Below 50 a switch on a timer becomes free energy.
MOD-483 Respirator: percent by which radiation dose builds slower. Deliberately below one suit piece (25%) - a skill must not replace the gear.
MOD-483 Selection: mutation chance added in the incubator (0.05 = five points). Applied to the base chance, so mutationChanceCap still has the last word.
MOD-483 Steady Hands: percent longer fuel burns in the owner's generators. Applied to burn LENGTH, not EU/t - a solar panel makes 1 EU/t and a percent of one is zero.
MOD-483 Swift Drone: ticks shaved off each block of garden-drone flight.
MOD-483 Tuned Drive: percent off machine operation length. Small on purpose next to an overclocker chip, which buys 25% speed for 60% more energy.
MOD-483 Wide Watering: multiplier on solution per pass that pays for the larger area (1.5 keeps the cost per tile roughly level; 1.0 hands out 49% free work).
MOD-483 Wide Watering: blocks added to sprinkler radius. Area grows with the SQUARE of it, which is why skillWideWateringCost exists.
